description: Native Windows herdr-core frames (#586), scrubbed. Every case crossed one ssh -T exec of `herdr-core connect` by the installer path, from a Mac, under sshd's default cmd.exe, on one machine: Windows PowerShell 5.1, an elevated SSH token and a core whose own token was elevated too. Each source says how the case was kept. Exact wire bytes: `bytes` of every entry in `frames` and of the eventFrames entry event-frame-size, and `line` of every entry in `errors`. `requestFrame` is rebuilt by the capture script and was checked equal to the frame it sent. Not wire bytes: `replyFrame`, `hello.reply`, `result`, the first-event-frame entry and every event `line` are rebuilt from scrubbed JSON, so their bytes and lengths differ from what the core sent. A frame is channel (u32 LE), kind (u8) and length (u32 LE) before its payload.
